campaign.title: The Long Way Home
campaign.approved_brief: Create a fully AI-generated, photorealistic, high-budget-looking vertical Instagram narrative film. An adult daughter drives her older father along a scenic mountain road in their cherished deep-green grand tourer. A childhood photograph inside a worn DIGI-TEC service-history wallet suggests their shared history and a trusted automotive-care relationship passed from father to daughter. The brand enters the story through that relationship. The film should inspire trust and loyalty through warmth, restraint and believable detail.
campaign.story_status: The approved concept remains active as a creative plan. Reference stills, the endcard, the reusable opening test and the eight-second review cut are preserved. The user explicitly requested a hold on all further paid generation. This is not a cancellation of the concept. The full commercial remains unfinished.
story_boundaries: All characters, cars and locations are AI-created for a fictional brand narrative.
Use an outdoor mountain setting. Do not return to the retired workshop storyboard.
The father is capable, engaged and happy to enjoy the passenger seat.
Do not depict racing, a collision, a breakdown, roadside assistance or a fear-based reason to seek service.
The service wallet is a fictional story prop. Do not present the characters as actual customers or invent a literal customer testimonial.
Do not imply manufacturer endorsement, guaranteed repair results or that the fictional location is DIGI-TEC's actual premises.

constraints: Keep each source clip to one controlled action and one camera move.
Use the approved car and cast references consistently; inspect every source at full resolution.
Avoid moving key exchanges, opening-and-extracting prop sequences, exact complex repairs, visible lip-sync and dense generated text.
Reject deformed hands, changing faces, extra fingers or limbs, drifting steering-wheel geometry, changing wheels, sliding tyres and unstable car proportions.
Keep dialogue and narration as separate audio assets with manually controlled timing.
Make the past visible through a still photograph, rather than a second animated cast and timeline.
Maintain ordinary driving behavior and coherent contact between tyres and road.
Do not promise that an approved still guarantees an acceptable motion result or that a rejected output can be fixed without cost.
